viewing_check: Estimate $60-120, current bid $50 (plus 22% premium). Andy should read the serial/model off the bell and neck, check for dents, bell and neck solder joints, pad condition (play-test impossible online) and whether keys move. A working YTS-23 has sold A$1,150-1,250 and a faulty one A$309-726 over the last 3 years; prices are steady. If it is a YTS-21 it may fetch slightly less. Collection is bulky (case is about 80 cm) but postable.
